summary: blockinfile options: required path (aliases dest, destfile, name), prepending a blank line, SELinux context fields, and state present or absent.
questions: How do I add a blank line before the managed block?
How do I remove a managed block entirely?

answer_card.title: blockinfile path, state, SELinux
answer_card.answer_md:
- `path` (required; aliases `dest`, `destfile`, `name`)
- `state`: `present` (default) / `absent`
- `prepend_newline` (false): blank line before block
- `seuser`/`serole`/`setype`/`selevel`: SELinux context
